scientific_integrity: The theorem provides a direct proof of exhaustive optimizer classification and counts; its general-minimum predecessor is explicitly credited, and the computational checks are reproducible and bounded.
scientific_limitations: Only minimum-cardinality semitotal dominating sets of once-subdivided complete bipartite graphs with p,q>=2. Does not enumerate all feasible higher-cardinality sets. Finite exhaustive tests are not infinite proofs. The minimum-cardinality formula and independent-minimum existence follow from earlier general subdivision literature. Unindexed priority overlap remains possible.
title: Star-complement rigidity and the exact minimum semitotal census of subdivided bicliques
